_note: Two checks need the cluster's Metrics API (Pod metrics). CRC ships with cluster monitoring DISABLED, so `oc adm top` and every HPA utilisation figure read <unknown> there and these two can never pass — they are excluded with a reason rather than silently skipped. On a cluster with user-workload monitoring (real DCS) remove the exclusions and they should pass. imagePullPolicy=Always forces a re-pull of the mutable samples/hello-dcs:1.0 tag.

exclude.reason: Needs the cluster Metrics API to serve Pod metrics; CRC runs with cluster monitoring disabled, so the HPA's current utilisation is permanently <unknown>. Passes on a cluster with user-workload monitoring enabled.
A scale-out decision requires the utilisation figure from the Metrics API; with no metrics the HPA never leaves minReplicas regardless of load. Passes where verify-hpa-has-metrics passes.
A SuccessfulRescale event only exists if the HPA actually rescaled, which needs the Metrics API. Passes where verify-hpa-has-metrics passes.
Asserts the HPA still reports a current CPU figure after the load stops — impossible without the Metrics API. Passes where verify-hpa-has-metrics passes.

steps.run: envsubst < deployment.yaml | oc apply -f - && oc apply -f service.yaml && oc patch deployment/hello-dcs --type=json -p '[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/imagePullPolicy","value":"Always"}]' && oc rollout status deploy/hello-dcs --timeout=180s

end=$(( $(date +%s) + 60 )); for i in $(seq 1 8); do ( while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$end" ]; do curl -s -o /dev/null "http://hello-dcs.$(oc project -q).svc:8080"; done ) & done; wait; echo load finished
